facts.fact: The Rwanda Bankers' Association states that Directive No. 45/2026 was issued by the National Bank of Rwanda on 9 January 2026 and completed the transition of bank and e-money issuer transfers to eKash.

The Rwanda Bankers' Association states that, effective 14 July 2026 under Directive No. 45/2026, every transfer between banks and electronic money issuers runs through the single eKash instant payment rail.

systems.country_label: eKash (Rwanda National Digital Payment System, RNDPS)
